entries.name: Quick
entries.summary: Base Movement is 8m.

entries.name: Slow
entries.summary: Base Movement is 4m.

entries.name: Burrower
entries.summary: Spend a Swift action with Movement to reach a space through connected diggable ground without triggering reactions.

entries.name: Climber
entries.summary: Climb vertical surfaces without movement penalties or checks. You may stop on the surface below 4m.

entries.name: Flier
entries.summary: Spend a Swift action when moving to become Airborne, generally up to 4m. At the end of each turn, pay 1 SP to remain airborne or land. Includes Glider.

entries.name: Glider
entries.summary: Avoid falling damage when able to glide.

entries.name: Grounded
entries.summary: Cannot use the Jump maneuver.

entries.name: Jumper
entries.summary: Jump up to full Movement.

entries.name: Phaser
entries.summary: Spend a Swift action when moving to travel through blocking terrain without ending there. Mental afflictions cost 1 SP each to bypass.

entries.name: Swimmer
entries.summary: Treat Ocean terrain as basic terrain in water or underwater.

entries.name: Teleporter
entries.summary: Spend Swift and Movement to reach a visible spot within Movement range without triggering reactions. Land on a surface unless you have Flier. Mental afflictions cost 1 SP each to bypass.

entries.name: Blender
entries.summary: Hide as a Swift action and gain a Stealth Boon when you can blend in.

entries.name: Blindsense
entries.summary: Gain Darkvision and immunity to Blinded. Spend 1 SP to enhance a relevant sense for up to 30 minutes.

entries.name: Darkvision
entries.summary: See through darkness and ignore its accuracy penalties.

entries.name: Form Change
entries.summary: Use separate sheets for forms. Keep total HP stat and external base-stat changes consistent across forms.

entries.name: Groundshaper
entries.summary: As a Swift action change nearby terrain within 2m. SP can extend the area or add fragile blocking terrain.

entries.name: Invisibility
entries.summary: Spend Swift and Movement to become invisible. Enemies take −4 accuracy and a Perception Bane. Actions are limited to movement or ending invisibility. Threats to concentration require Focus or 1 SP.

entries.name: Living Weapon
entries.summary: Possess the Trainer’s weapon as an Extended action. While equipped, the Pokémon leaves the party and its damaging weapon attacks become Ghost type.

entries.name: Mountable
entries.summary: An adjacent creature can mount or dismount a willing active Pokémon as a Swift action. Both share space and move together using the mount’s movement capabilities.

entries.name: Naturewalk
entries.summary: Ignore Slowed and rough terrain penalties in the listed environments.

entries.name: Reach
entries.summary: Extend melee attacks and maneuvers to 2m for Small or Medium users and 3m for Large or bigger users. Attack of Opportunity is excluded.

entries.name: Shadow Meld
entries.summary: Merge into a shadow as a Standard or Extended action, becoming untargetable with limited actions. Emerge adjacent as a Movement action. Outside combat, the first 10 minutes are free and each additional hour costs 1 SP.

entries.name: Telekinetic
entries.summary: Lift objects within 10m with Focus and spend 1 SP for +2 Power for an hour. Disarm, Hinder, Push, and Trip can use Focus at 6m.

entries.name: Threaded
entries.summary: Create thread or vine appendages. Most Tactic maneuvers can target from 5m, with Push pulling toward you.

entries.name: Truant
entries.summary: Standard-action damaging attacks take a Full action.

entries.name: Underdog
entries.summary: Identifies Pokémon with a base stat total of 45 or less, with exceptions.

entries.name: Wallshaper
entries.summary: Concentrate to create blocking walls within 5m, using a Standard or Extended action. Walls ignore physical damage but cannot support Weight Class 4 or higher.

entries.name: Wielder
entries.summary: Equip a weapon of the listed type and gain its attacks and keywords. Spend a Swift action to use a damaging attack as a weapon attack at the weapon’s range.

entries.name: Alluring
entries.summary: Emit a pleasant scent.

entries.name: Amorphous
entries.summary: Reshape your body to squeeze through tight spaces.

entries.name: Aura Reader
entries.summary: Read a living creature’s aura for clues about personality, mood, and intent.

entries.name: Breathless
entries.summary: You do not need to breathe and cannot suffocate.

entries.name: Chilled
entries.summary: Emit cold that helps creatures in range ignore Harsh Heat.

entries.name: Dream Reader
entries.summary: View adjacent sleepers’ dreams. Spend 1 SP to shape a touched sleeper’s dream or project it.

entries.name: Dead Silent
entries.summary: Move silently while concentrating.

entries.name: Empath
entries.summary: Sense surface emotions within 10m. Spend 1 SP and roll Focus to read deeper emotions within 5m.

entries.name: Engine
entries.summary: Merge with a motor or vehicle. Varoom and Revavroom may gain compatible traits or attacks.

entries.name: Gilled
entries.summary: Avoid suffocation damage underwater.

entries.name: Glow
entries.summary: Emit light and offset Low Lighting within a radius based on your size.

entries.name: Heater
entries.summary: Emit warmth that offsets Harsh Cold within a radius based on your size.

entries.name: Illusionist
entries.summary: Create small visual illusions as a Swift or Extended action. Spend 3 SP minus Tier Level and concentrate to lift one restriction.

entries.name: Magnetic
entries.summary: Attract or repel iron and steel, detect disturbances within 50m, and communicate with other Magnetic users.

entries.name: Mender
entries.summary: Produce a medicinal substance that works like a First Aid Kit.

entries.name: Mindlock
entries.summary: Gain a Boon on opposed Focus checks and detect attempts to affect your mind or spirit. Winning the opposition reveals clues and blocks further attempts by that user this scene.

entries.name: Mind Weaver
entries.summary: Touch a creature’s head to read or erase memories through opposed Focus unless willing. Additional effort can reach older memories.

entries.name: Pack Mon
entries.summary: Trainers gain a Command Boon with Pokémon. Social checks against a Pokémon with this capability gain a Boon if it has no leader or a Bane if it respects its leader.

entries.name: Premonition
entries.summary: Sense an impending disaster with clarity depending on proximity and method. Spend SP for more detail.

entries.name: Repulsive
entries.summary: Emit an unpleasant scent.

entries.name: Shapeshifter
entries.summary: Change shape as a Standard or Extended action within 50% of your mass. Copies do not gain the original’s traits or complex functions.

entries.name: Soul Seer
entries.summary: Observe souls for clues about injury and disposition. Close range and sustained attention reveal more detail.

entries.name: Telepath
entries.summary: Project and read thoughts within 10m through opposed Focus if unwilling. Spending SP and making a Focus check can reveal deeper thoughts.

entries.name: Thermal Vision
entries.summary: Focus for at least one minute to see in infrared.

entries.name: Tremorsense
entries.summary: Detect objects in or on the ground within 10m. Unusual surfaces may require a CR 2 Focus or Intuition check.

entries.name: Tracker
entries.summary: Follow a known scent on a CR 2 Perception check or recall past scents on a CR 4 check.

entries.name: True Sight
entries.summary: See through illusions and invisibility.

entries.name: Wired
entries.summary: Travel instantly between devices linked by cables. Rotom may possess a device and gain an attack.

entries.name: X-Ray Vision
entries.summary: Focus for one minute to see blurry shapes beyond blocking terrain within 2m.
